issue.title: capture-rewrite switches a mid-line transfer source +id on typed ^ or :, breaking the transfer

task_type_fields.impact: Editing a transfer line mid-line in Bob Mac Capture: typing `^` or `:` after a source `+id` silently rewrites it into a source form the transfer rejects (`transfer_source_marker`), instead of leaving the key literal. Low frequency (needs a mid-line edit), but it contradicts the documented contract and turns a valid move into an error.
task_type_fields.repro:
Reproduce with a `bob` built from master 345e1438 (the cursor sits right after the typed key, before ` > @db`):

```bash
bob capture-rewrite -c 13 -f json -- '@inbox+bench^ > @db'   # -> "@inbox^bench > @db", rule switch_block_id_separator
bob capture-rewrite -c 13 -f json -- '@inbox+bench: > @db'   # -> "@inbox:bench > @db"
bob capture-rewrite -c 13 -f json -- '@inbox+bench^ > @c+tid' # -> "@inbox^bench > @c+tid"
bob capture-parse -f json -- '@inbox^bench > @db'            # mode incomplete, diagnostic transfer_source_marker
```

The capture-rewrite help (`src/native/capture_rewrite.rs` long_about) and `docs/capture.md` both promise "':' or '^' after a transfer '+id' stays literal, since it would break the transfer". That holds at the end of the line (`@a+x > @c+tid:` stays literal, covered by `rewrite_draft_leaves_transfer_plus_triggers_for_other_marks_literal`), but not when the key is typed after a source while the arrow and destination already follow.

Root cause: in `switch_block_id_separator` (`src/native/capture_language/rewrite.rs`), the `transfer_claims_marker` guard (`scan_transfer_line` on the trigger-removed candidate) runs only `if trigger == b'.'`. Typed `:`/`^` skip it, and `candidate_selects_plain_marker` accepts the `@inbox+bench` source as a plain marker. Likely fix: run that guard for every non-`+` trigger when the separator is `+` (or for all `:`/`^` resolutions), then add the mid-line source cases to the transfer-literal unit test. A glued `.` is already guarded and stays literal there.

issue.creation_reason: Found while planning the glued-dot @route+id switch: the help promises ':'/'^' after a transfer '+id' stay literal, but mid-line sources switch.
